Name: DeepSeek-korbus
Author: SuperKong47
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
A DeepSeek blue-fish replacement for Krobus. The mod keeps the original Heartstone walk animation at its full [b]128×128[/b] pixel quality and scales it at runtime, so Krobus stays sharp while fitting Stardew Valley's NPC proportions.
It also adds a Q-version portrait with [b]six expressions[/b], a matching friendship/social-menu thumbnail, a [b]two-frame hug[/b], random idle actions, and an optional Chinese dialogue pack written in the community “big blue fish” persona.
Current version: [b]5.7.0[/b] (2026-10-24).
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/b] and [b]Content Patcher 2.9.1+[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded zip.[/*]
[*]Copy these three folders directly into the game's 
[code]Mods[/code] folder:
[list]
[*][code][SMAPI] DeepSeekKrobusScaled[/code][/*]
[*][code][CP] DeepSeekKrobus[/code][/*]
[*][code][CP] DeepSeekKrobusDialogue[/code][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Make sure each folder contains 
[code]manifest.json[/code] directly. Do not nest the three folders inside another folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]When upgrading, replace all three folders instead of merging them with an older version. Back up your save before testing modded NPC visuals.
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Original-quality walk animation[/b] — uses the original 128×128 Heartstone frames through a small SMAPI/Harmony renderer; the texture is not downscaled.[/*]
[*][b]Runtime scale 1.15×[/b] — Krobus is resized at draw time, with a [b]16×32[/b] collision box.[/*]
[*][b]Four walking directions[/b] and a [b]two-frame hug[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Random idle actions[/b] after 30 seconds of standing still: idle, dance, eat, basin and hair-adjust.
[list]
[*]Each action lasts about 4 seconds.[/*]
[*]Actions trigger regardless of facing direction.[/*]
[*]The source clips only have east/west views, so actions use a side-view pose even when Krobus faces down.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Q-version portrait[/b] with six expressions: calm, happy, sad, shy, blush and angry.[/*]
[*][b]Friendship/social-menu thumbnail[/b] — a crisp 64×64 Q-version bust.[/*]
[*][b]Optional dialogue pack[/b] — daily/general lines in the “big blue fish” voice, using 
[code]@[/code], 
[code]$h[/code], 
[code]$s[/code], 
[code]$a[/code], 
[code]$l[/code], 
[code]#$b#[/code] and a 
[code]$q[/code]/
[code]$r[/code] exchange (“token来token来token来” / “token回token回token回”).
[list]
[*]Dialogue is Chinese.[/*]
[*]Heart events, quest scripts and special event dialogue are untouched.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Static CP fallback[/b] — 
[code][CP] DeepSeekKrobus[/code] supplies the portrait, six-expression sheet, social fallback and a static fallback sprite.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] (or a later 1.6.x version)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher 2.9.1+[/b][/*]
[*]No other dependencies.[/*]
[/list]The appearance part is a [b]SMAPI code mod[/b], not a Content Patcher-only mod. If another mod replaces Krobus' sprite, portrait or dialogue, load order matters; place these packs after other Krobus visual/dialogue mods.
[heading]Shout outs[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b] for Stardew Valley and Krobus.[/*]
[*]The creator of the[b] animation[/b] used as the base for the walk, idle, dance, eat, basin and hair-adjust animations:
[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV179nq6WEis/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&vd_source=91c13137bea6fc444c57e15cc664b93a]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV179nq6WEis/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&vd_source=91c13137bea6fc444c57e15cc664b93a[/url][/*]
[/list][list]
[*]The [b]SMAPI[/b], [b]Content Patcher[/b] and [b]Harmony[/b] teams for the modding tools.[/*]
[*]The commissioner and artists who provided the DeepSeek blue-fish artwork and portrait templates.[/*]
[/list][b]Permissions:[/b] please do not reupload the animation or artwork assets as standalone files. Contact the author for permission before reusing them in another mod.
